Yes — that's clear and does what I wanted. Switching Sort from "Newest first" to "Name A–Z" reshuffled the cards into alphabetical order right away, and having the Sort control sitting up beside the result count is a sensible spot — it's right there where I'm looking at how many I've got, so I don't have to hunt for it. Having newest, oldest, and A–Z to choose from covers how I'd want to arrange things.

And the rule feels right too. Newest-first as the starting order makes sense — the things I just saved are usually what I care about most. And having my chosen order carry through whichever view I'm in — the whole library, a single label, or a search — is exactly right; I wouldn't want to reset the sort every time I click into a label. Sorting's good.
